units.rawText: I feel like I've been running for a long time. My whole body aches from head to toe.
units.displayText: I feel like I've been running for a long time. My whole body aches from head to toe.

spans.text: I feel like I've been running for a long time. My whole body aches from head to toe.

units.rawText: I think I saw other people along the way apart from the robots.
units.displayText: I think I saw other people along the way apart from the robots.

spans.text: I think I saw other people along the way apart from the robots.

units.rawText: But they weren't there to help Mayushii, so Mayushii had to chase them away.
units.displayText: But they weren't there to help Mayushii, so Mayushii had to chase them away.

spans.text: But they weren't there to help Mayushii, so Mayushii had to chase them away.

units.rawText: I'm very tired, but at last, at long last!
units.displayText: I'm very tired, but at last, at long last!

spans.text: I'm very tired, but at last, at long last!

units.rawText: Mayushii's found the Lab at last!
units.displayText: Mayushii's found the Lab at last!

spans.text: Mayushii's found the Lab at last!

units.rawText: I look up at the familiar building before me. As I thought, the Lab was among those buildings.
units.displayText: I look up at the familiar building before me. As I thought, the Lab was among those buildings.

spans.text: I look up at the familiar building before me. As I thought, the Lab was among those buildings.

units.rawText: Mayushii will be able to see everyone soon! Okarin, Daru-kun, Kurisu-chan, Faris-chan, Luka-kun...
units.displayText: Mayushii will be able to see everyone soon! Okarin, Daru-kun, Kurisu-chan, Faris-chan, Luka-kun...

spans.text: Mayushii will be able to see everyone soon! Okarin, Daru-kun, Kurisu-chan, Faris-chan, Luka-kun...

units.rawText: It'll all be fine once Mayushii chases off all these people blocking Mayushii's way. Mayushii will be able to see everyone!
units.displayText: It'll all be fine once Mayushii chases off all these people blocking Mayushii's way. Mayushii will be able to see everyone!

spans.text: It'll all be fine once Mayushii chases off all these people blocking Mayushii's way. Mayushii will be able to see everyone!
